predecessors.name: Roman Empire
predecessors.text: Texandria, south of the Rhine-Meuse delta, the land the Salians had settled 'with Roman consent' and which Julian let them keep

successors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
successors.text: Clovis's realm in 509: the Salian kingdom with the northern half of Alamannia, Armorica and Aquitaine added in 496-507 (see the ledger), together with the Ripuarian kingdom of Cologne he took over…

ledger.x: 358: Julian lets the Salian Franks keep Texandria.
486: Clovis wins at Soissons and takes Syagrius's domain.
496: Clovis beats the Alamanni at Tolbiac.
501: Clovis leads his troops to Armorica.
507: Clovis wins at Vouillé and takes most of Aquitaine.
509: Clovis takes over the Ripuarian kingdom of Cologne.
509: the Salian kingdom becomes the kingdom of all the Franks.

wars.name: Julian's campaign against the Salian Franks
wars.outcome: The Salians sent a deputation to Tongeren in the winter of 357/8; Julian authorised them to keep the lands they had settled and they had to supply soldiers to the Roman army.

wars.name: Chlodio's conquest of Tournai and Cambrai
wars.outcome: The Franks hold Turnacum and Cameracum and the country up to the Somme.

wars.name: Childeric I's Loire campaigns
wars.outcome: Childeric fights near the Loire and takes Angers after Count Paul's death; no dated change of border.

wars.name: Battle of Soissons
wars.outcome: Clovis defeats Syagrius, who flees to the Visigoths and is handed over for execution; the Domain of Soissons ends and the Frankish border reaches the Loire.

wars.name: Clovis's campaign against the Thuringians
wars.outcome: 'Clovis allegedly moved against a small number of Thuringians in eastern Gaul, near the Burgundian border'; no territory recorded.

wars.name: Battle of Tolbiac
wars.outcome: The Alamanni are defeated and their leader killed; the northern half of their lands passes to the Franks.

wars.name: Clovis's war against Gundobad at Dijon
wars.outcome: 'After some months, Clovis was convinced to abandon the siege and settled for an annual tribute from Gundobad.'

wars.name: Clovis's Armorican campaign
wars.outcome: 'Armorica and its fighters were thus integrated into the Frankish realm.'

wars.name: Battle of Vouillé
wars.outcome: The Visigothic kingdom of Toulouse is defeated; 'The battle added most of Aquitaine to Clovis's kingdom.'

certainty.note: No treaty line anywhere in the life: Julian's 358 terms name Texandria but no boundary, the Somme and the Loire are rivers named by the Soissons page, and the Alemannic, Armorican and Aquitanian lands are approximate.
